description: Run a 3D operation for the title: generate a mesh from text, an image or views; a Gaussian splat; views from an image and their edits; texture, retopology, smart UV, segmentation and part completion, format conversion, import, rig check, rigging and animation retargeting. auto-rig is the platform's own biped rig of a standing T- or A-pose character (done at once, joints found automatically; its result takes library-animation clips, not retarget). library-animation puts ready clips from the platform animation library (list_animation_library) on a rigged model — cheaper than retarget, done at once, walk/run in place by default (options.animate_in_place=false keeps the forward motion). A finished job id is the input of the next step (input_task_id). ASYNC: returns a job with an id and status — poll get_three_d for the result.

animations.description: retarget: up to 5 animation presets, e.g. preset:walk. library-animation: clip ids from list_animation_library, e.g. idle, walk, run.

edit_prompts.description: edit-multiview: one to four view edits.

front_url.description: Front view URL: multiview-to-3d or texture by views (optional).

hint.description: smart-segment: which parts to look for (optional).

image_url.description: Source image URL: image-to-3d, image-to-splat, image-to-multiview, smart-segment, texture reference (optional).

input_task_id.description: Previous 3D job id whose result is the input (optional).

model.description: Model name, if you insist on a specific one (optional). ⚠ Setting it cancels the tier COMPLETELY — together with its provider and its settings — so params may stop applying. Prefer `tier`.

model_url.description: Source model URL when there is no previous job (optional).

operation.description: text-to-3d | image-to-3d | multiview-to-3d | image-to-splat | image-to-multiview | edit-multiview | texture | retopology | smart-uv | segment | smart-segment | complete | convert | import | rig-check | rig | retarget | auto-rig | library-animation.

options.description: Tripo settings by vendor name, e.g. {"geometry_model":"P2-20260801","face_limit":5000,"quad":true,"rig_type":"biped","format":"FBX"} (optional; the tier fills the rest).

params.description: Model settings, as declared by the vendor for the chosen tier — for example {"aspect_ratio":"16:9","resolution":"720p","duration":"4"}. Call list_ai_tiers to see which keys this tier accepts, their allowed values and defaults. Values are strings. Unknown keys are ignored rather than rejected.

provider.description: Provider key, if you insist on one (optional). Cancels the tier the same way.

style_image_url.description: Texture style image URL, only with a prompt (optional).

tier.description: Quality/price tier, e.g. image-cheap or video-premium. Call list_ai_tiers for the current list. Omit it to use this title's default tier.

title_id.description: Which game this is for — a label for the report, optional. Credits are always the publisher's, so leaving it out is normal for assets that belong to no game.

name: generate_three_d
title: Generate 3D model
